summary: The candidate adds useful schema, resolver, capture, gate, and region-inventory primitives, and its focused tests and toy GPU rollout pass. It does not fully implement the open feature: no production path loads/resolves a manifest or passes a resolution into DenoisingStage, so runtime behavior remains the pre-existing global compile policy. Independent adversarial tests also show that NaN tensor and output metrics pass the gate and tensor-valued terminal state comparison raises instead of returning a rejection.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: the recorded base has no trajectory compile manifest/gate implementation; import raises ModuleNotFoundError.
Exact candidate commit focused regression suite: 18 passed.

Real torch.compile/Inductor execution on AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950): eager versus compiled four-step toy state rollout passed, reset/short rollout passed, and an injected step-1 perturbation was rejected. This is not a diffusion/model-semantic qualification.

Independent adversarial contract cases: NaN checkpoint metrics passed with no failures; a NaN public metric passed with no failures; equal tensor-valued terminal states raised RuntimeError due to ambiguous tensor truth value.
Production wiring audit: resolver/manifest/capture APIs occur only in their new utility module; DenoisingStage only accepts an optional CompilePlanResolution, and no production caller supplies one.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950, Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. Candidate toy GPU script completed with maximum per-step absolute error 1.1920928955078125e-07. Torch emitted non-fatal Dynamo metrics serialization errors.

remaining_counterexamples: A candidate checkpoint containing NaN is promoted because all threshold comparisons against NaN evaluate false.
A model/output adapter returning NaN is promoted for the same reason.
Tensor-valued terminal state mappings raise RuntimeError during direct mapping inequality instead of producing a structural gate failure.

No server/configuration or request path constructs CompilePlanResolver, derives the current workload signature, loads a manifest, or passes resolved_plan to DenoisingStage; therefore an uncovered production request is not made eager by this feature.
No real diffusion or stateful world-model trajectory validates history regimes, cache on/off, CFG serial/parallel, reset isolation, mutation/alias metadata, or semantic output metrics.
remaining_limitations: No production model weights were available, so model-semantic accuracy and architecture-specific behavior were not tested.
Only one AMD gfx950 GPU was used; distributed and other GPU architectures were not tested.
No native source changed in the candidate and repository-environment.json declares no native build target, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
The candidate GPU script is a small Linear/tanh toy and does not exercise DenoisingStage regional compilation, cache wrappers, CFG, manifests, fallback metrics, or a serving path.
Cold/warm timing was observed only for the toy script; p50/p95, graph breaks, recompiles, and peak memory were not independently qualified.
